options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: featurestore
options.description: The name of the Featurestore to use, in the format projects/{project}/locations/{location}/featurestores/{featurestore}. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: labels
options.description: A set of key/value label pairs to assign to this EntityType. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.

options.name: monitoring_config
options.description: The default monitoring configuration for all Features under this EntityType. If this is populated with [FeaturestoreMonitoringConfig.monitoring_interval] specified, snapshot analysis monitoring is enabled. Otherwise, snapshot analysis monitoring is disabled.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the EntityType. This value may be up to 60 characters, and valid characters are [a-z0-9_]. The first character cannot be a number. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: offline_storage_ttl_days
options.description: Config for data retention policy in offline storage. TTL in days for feature values that will be stored in offline storage. The Feature Store offline storage periodically removes obsolete feature values older than offlineStorageTtlDays since the feature generation time. If unset (or explicitly set to 0), default to 4000 days TTL.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.
